items.title: Live: Isaac Herzog lays wreath at Bondi to commemorate victims of antisemitic attack
items.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has arrived in Sydney for a four-day visit following the Bondi Beach terror attack. Follow live.

items.title: Israeli president begins controversial visit to mourn Bondi attack victims
items.description: Isaac Herzog was invited by the governor-general and prime minister to join the Jewish community grieving the loss of life in the December 14 massacre of mostly Jewish Australians at a Hanukkah event.

items.title: Young people could get massive pay boost in 'totemic' wage case
items.description: "I'm paying adult fuel with still a child's wage," says Ben Walker, one of the almost half a million young people who could see a huge boost to their wage.

items.title: Liberals despair at prospect of 'non-existence' and weigh leadership change
items.description: Sussan Ley could face a challenge to her leadership from Angus Taylor this week after a disastrous opinion poll showed the Coalition parties falling further behind One Nation.

items.title: One Nation's rising support is inextricably linked to the housing crisis
items.description: Pauline Hanson might not have any substantive policies, but her rhetoric about reducing migration is clearly finding an audience.

items.title: Psychedelic PTSD treatment for veterans to be funded under $740m plan
items.description: A $740 million program will expand support for veterans and include funding for social activities such as yoga and language classes, with new treatment including MDMA and psilocybin for the worst forms of PTSD also funded for the first time.

items.title: Live: Patriots star 'rattled' as Super Bowl LX half-time show approaches
items.description: The Seahawks and Patriots meet in the Super Bowl in a rematch of a thrilling clash 11 years ago that ended in an iconic finish for the ages. Follow live.

items.title: Live: ASX rallies strongly after Wall Street rebound
items.description: The ASX has rebounded strongly after dropping 1.8 per cent last week. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Tropical Cyclone Mitchell downgraded to category one system
items.description: Residents are sheltering as destructive winds and heavy rain lash the tourist towns in north-west WA.

items.title: The harrowing silence after Vonn's crash showed everyone wanted to believe
items.description: Lindsey Vonn's shocking downhill crash at the 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Olympic Games was always a possibility given the American was competing just nine days after rupturing her ACL. But it was never going to stop her from trying.

items.title: 'It was a them thing': Epstein files spotlight Maxwell's role
items.description: This week, Ghislaine Maxwell could be a very unwelcome distraction for Donald Trump as she appears before one of America's top political institutions.

items.title: Prickly businessman tied to massive tobacco fine says there's a deeper story
items.description: He's been declared bankrupt repeatedly, and was a gambling addict. Now he's linked to a $1.5 million fine for illegal tobacco.

items.title: UK prime minister's powerful chief of staff quits amid Epstein fallout
items.description: Sir Keir Starmer's leadership is under threat after revelations that one of his former US ambassadors had close ties with Jeffrey Epstein.

items.title: Iranian Nobel Peace Prize winner sentenced to further jail time
items.description: Women's rights activist Narges Mohammadi is sentenced to a further six years in jail.

items.title: Bail law amendments result in more First Nation remands, researchers find
items.description: A study has found increasing "punitive" bail law amendments are negatively affecting First Nations people.

items.title: Gout opts out of Commonwealth Games as he seeks to follow in Usain Bolt's footsteps
items.description: Sprint sensation Gout Gout pulls out of the Glasgow Commonwealth Games in a major blow to the Australian team.

items.title: Why Wuthering Heights is one of the year's most controversial adaptations
items.description: Days away from the release of Emerald Fennell's highly anticipated adaptation of Emily Brontë's classic novel, critics and fans alike are still fighting about text fidelity in the comments.

items.title: Mother claims missed warning signs in NT hospital led to baby's disabilities
items.description: Mia Pilbrow is taking legal action against a Northern Territory hospital and calling for the territory to adopt tailored pre-term labour guidelines, after medical staff sent her home seven times during her pregnancy, repeatedly assuring her the baby was fine.

items.title: Cyclists say Sydney Fish Market bike route 'accident waiting to happen'
items.description: The decision to put a shared bike path in front of the new Sydney Fish Market is causing a clash between commuter cyclists and visitors to the site, riders say.

items.title: Backyard pods won't fix the housing crisis but they signal a shift
items.description: Australia's biggest hardware retailer has started selling tiny homes. Are backyard pods the answer to a national housing crisis?

items.title: Japan's 'Iron Lady' leads coalition to landslide election victory
items.description: Sanae Takaichi's Liberal Democratic Party and its coalition partner are expected to hold upwards of two-thirds of the seats in Japan's lower house.

items.title: Court order brings end to long-running saga over 'eyesore' hotel property
items.description: After years of complaints from local authorities, a judge has ordered the sale of the property which sits surrounded by temporary fencing, with smashed windows and timber boards nailed across its seven-storey façade.

items.title: New bushfires a stark reminder that Black Summer recovery still not over
items.description: Residents who lived through the 2019-20 bushfires on the NSW South Coast say this summer's fires triggered traumatic memories, and highlighted the recovery and resilience projects that remain unfinished.

items.title: Wild weather puts marine ecosystems at risk of 'underwater blackouts', study finds
items.description: For the first time a group of international scientists have measured the impact of what happens to marine life when the lights go out underwater.

items.title: As Perth prepares for AFL Origin, will a new generation embrace the concept?
items.description: The AFL is about to reboot the State of Origin concept, with the clash between Western Australia and Victoria at Perth Stadium next Saturday — on Valentine's Day — set to show if there's any love left for the idea.
